editorial_thesis: The day's signal moved from what agents can do to on whose terms: ownership of policy, data, money, and platform is now the contested surface, backed by $110M+ in agent-data funding and a viral trust essay.

topic_groups.title: Agent Data Economy
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Largest funding cluster of the day plus a fresh Show HN tool; the data-platform-for-agents thesis has not been covered since mid-November's agent-ready data lanes.
